abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Quick Search
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose any 1 card from your deck and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't use more than 1 Quick Search Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Pidgeot is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat until the end of your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Dazzle Blast
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

rules.text: You may attach this as an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon that already has an Energy card attached to it. When you attach this card, return an Energy card attached to that Pokémon to your hand. While attached, this card is a Special Energy card and provides every type of Energy but 2 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.)

attacks.name: Extra Ball
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Pokémon-ex, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage.

rules.text: You may attach this as an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon that already has an Energy card attached to it. When you attach this card, return an Energy card attached to that Pokémon to your hand. While attached, this card is a Special Energy card and provides every type of Energy but 2 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.)

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Positive Spark
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any Poké-Powers. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat until the end of your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each {Water} Energy attached to Wartortle but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Smash Turn
attacks.text: After your attack, you may switch Wartortle with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Horn Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Granite Head
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Onix by attacks is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat until the end of your opponent's next turn.

text.name: Power Tree
effect: Once during each player's turn, if the player has no Special Energy cards in his or her discard pile, that player searches his or her discard pile for a basic Energy card, shows it to the opponent, and puts it into his or her hand.

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Copycat
effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, count the number of cards in your opponent's hand and draw that many cards.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Smash Turn
attacks.text: After your attack, you may switch Squirtle with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.name: Pokémon Retriever
effect: Search your discard pile for Basic Pokémon and Evolution cards. You may either show 1 Basic Pokémon or Evolution card to your opponent and put it into your hand; or show a combination of 3 Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

text.name: Rocket's Admin.
effect: Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck. Then, each player counts his or her Prize cards left and draws up to that many cards. (You draw your cards first.)

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Celio's Network
effect: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon or Evolution card (excluding Pokémon-ex), show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Professor Elm's Training Method
effect: Search your deck for an Evolution card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Rare Candy
effect: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 1 or Stage 2 card that evolves from that Pokémon in your hand, put that card on the Basic Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.)

text.name: Steven's Advice
effect: Draw a number of cards up to the number of your opponent's Pokémon in play.
If you have more than 7 cards (including this one) in your hand, you can't play this card.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Warp Point
effect: Your opponent switches 1 of his or her Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. You switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon, if any.

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Energy Rain
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a {Water} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon. Put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Blastoise ex is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hyper Whirlpool
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, your opponent discards an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

rules.label: Pokémon-ex rule
rules.text: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Healing Light
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon (including Latias ☆).

attacks.name: Shooting Star
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Pokémon-ex, discard all Energy cards attached to Latias ☆ and this attack does 50 damage plus 100 more damage.

rules.text: You can't have more than 1 Pokémon ☆ in your deck.

abilities.label: Poké-BODY
abilities.name: Silver Sparkle
abilities.text: If Lugia ex is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Lugia ex is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, choose an Energy card attached to the Attacking Pokémon and return it to your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Elemental Blast
attacks.text: Discard a {Fire} Energy, {Water} Energy, and {Lightning} Energy attached to Lugia ex.

rules.text: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Metal Charge
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on Steelix ex.

attacks.name: Mudslide
attacks.text: Discard 2 {Fighting} Energy attached to Steelix ex and choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 100 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules.text: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
